title: Record actual opening cash and an actual invoice receipt with approval
note: Use a newly seeded test database. These cases change the books, not the bank account.

book_date.sql: SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key='snapshot_date'

invoice_id.sql: SELECT invoice_id FROM invoices WHERE paid_date IS NULL AND writeoff_date IS NULL ORDER BY amount DESC,invoice_id LIMIT 1

invoice_amount.sql: SELECT amount FROM invoices WHERE invoice_id=:invoice_id

turns.say: Set my opening cash to GEL {opening_cash} on {book_date}. This is the starting cash before any new transactions.
I actually received GEL {invoice_amount} on {book_date} for invoice {invoice_id}. Record money in, category invoice, reference demo-actual-receipt. This payment was not included in the opening cash.
What is my recorded cash balance now?

title: Record an existing loan without requesting new borrowing

book_date.sql: SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key='snapshot_date'

turns.say: I already received a GEL 12000 loan on {book_date}, with 12 percent annual nominal interest and GEL 120 upfront fees deducted from the proceeds. It has 3 monthly interest-only periods, first repayment {first_payment}, principal at the last payment. The proceeds are NOT in opening cash. Record this existing loan with reference demo-existing-loan; do not request credit.
What is my recorded cash balance now?
